en: A vintage French military field postcard titled "CORRESPONDANCE DES ARMÉES EN CAMPAGNE" with the large red text "CARTE EN FRANCHISE" across the center. At the top right there is a cluster of four Allied flags (United Kingdom, France, Belgium, and Russia) tied together with a tricolor ribbon. The left side contains pre‑printed French fields for the sender's details (name, grade, regiment, company/escadron/battalion). The right side is for the addressee, written in cursive, with a purple circular military postmark stamped over part of the card.
